disposition_reason: WHO GEMS/Food individual and aggregated results for every food: Pb, Cd, Hg, Al, Sn, Ni and Cr from the June 2026 export and every arsenic species from the May 2026 per-region exports.

study.origin: Submitting WHO region; FoodOriginName gives domestic/imported only
study.method: per submitting laboratory or programme method

unresolved: Country identity is not in the export, so WHO region cannot be read as growing origin.

dataset.scope: Scoped subset for ingredients/rice-protein only (HMI-PROTEIN-PEA-RICE-1). The full GEMS/Food shards are kept outside the repository; this file set is replaced when they are synced.
